Geographies Served Programs Buniyaad District Mumbai Suburban State Maharashtra District Mumbai Suburban States Maharashtra The last few decades have been particularly important in showing substantial growth with its innovation and invention in the field of technology, automation, and education. In order to keep pace with the changing times, it is of utmost importance to move with changing variables. There is a felt need to modify the existing schools and industry curriculum and environment to match the pace at which the world around us is changing. Objective-Adopt and equip the government and private-aided schools in Mumbai to make them future ready Renovation and upgradation of the external school infrastructure making it child-friendly Structured Learning through developing a STEAM lab which focuses on building the capacity of teachers and students to realistically, scientifically, and creatively think and solve problems. Develop Smart Classrooms to provide digital based education to program schools, with involvement of parents as well as the community in education Bulandi District Bangalore New Delhi Hyderabad Pune Mumbai State Karnataka Delhi Maharashtra Telangana District Bangalore New Delhi Hyderabad Pune Mumbai States Karnataka Delhi Maharashtra Telangana Bulandi is a 3-month training programme run for young people, who are known as aspirants, between the age of 18–25 years in the marginalized communities in Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana and Delhi. The training helps them to develop themselves through 21st century skills, IT skills training, workplace readiness, career development, mentoring support, digital empowerment, internship and placement opportunities that will help them convert their passion into gainful employment. They are also given domain specific training on courses like Customer relationship retail and sales (CRS)/ITeS/ BFSI or related courses that will help them to get employment in the job roles like Customer sales associate/service, Customer relationship service, Tele-calling executive, Data entry operator etc. them plan long term and short-term career goals for a holistic career growth. Badi Soch District Mumbai Suburban State Maharashtra District Mumbai Suburban States Maharashtra Bright Future is giving a platform for under-privileged young people coming from the marginalized communities of Mumbai who have never got an opportunity or exposure to start their own business. Through our Badi Soch initiative we aim to equip them with basic entrepreneurship skills which will help them to start, grow and scale up their business and earn livelihood for themselves. Badi Soch is a customised program which will also give personal mentoring support to every youth aspirant to overcome their challenges and get personal coaching from their role model. The purpose for this Badi Soch initiative is to provide supportive platform for underprivileged youth belonging to marginalized communities to become entrepreneurs Aasman District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra Bright Future has 55% of aspirants who are female aspirants in our programs We have realised that lot of these young girls face personal challenges to pursue their desired education even if they have dreams, many of them don't get conducive support from family to complete their education. There are many young women who have fought many obstacles and finally decided to get back to studies and hence Bright Future has decided to support them financially. Goal of Asmaan is to empower the young girls from marginalised communities with scholarship support to meet their aspirational education and leadership skills. Target beneficiaries: 18 to 25 years of young girls from marginalised communities from existing Bright Future communities of Govandi, Bhandup, Nalasopara in Mumbai Milestones & Track Record Bright Future has expanded its reach to 40,000+ beneficiaries across Maharashtra, Delhi, Telangana, and Karnataka, established 17 operational Bulandi Livelihood training centers, and covered 16 schools through the Buniyad program. --> --> Leadership Team Kishor Palve Founder and CEO Prachi Muktibodh Manager- Sustainability Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AABTN2454N Registration Number E-26080 (Mumbai Trust Act) CSR Form 1 CSR00000754 VO ID / Darpan ID MH/2015/0092663 --> 80G AABTN2454NF20214 12A AABTN2454NE20214 FCRA 83781420 About Headquarters Mumbai, Maharashtra Since 2009 Demographies Served Youth Women --> Impact The success of our programs is not only measured by the number of young people we are able to reach but the ecosystem we create to ensure their success. We build capacities for key stakeholders like parents, teachers, mentors and employers so that we set up our beneficiaries for success at home, school and work. Vision and Mission Bright Future's vision is 'A Bright Future for all young people,' and its mission is to 'Facilitate young people to become changemakers in the community by developing their future skills'.
